plain: New semantic spacing (semantic.space.fixed.*) and radius (semantic.radius.scale.*) tokens cover every px value; reach for them instead of a primitive step or a typed px.

steps.plain: Deprecated spacing, radius and type tokens (the hds#206 layout.* and component.gap/padding aliases, section.heroMax, docs.space.paragraph/inline, typography.h1-h3/eyebrow) leave in 1.0.0; the codemod rewrites each to the replacement it names, and hds/no-deprecated-token fails what is left.
